objective: Implement one opt-in v4.2 wire-compatibility layer that composes the frozen v4.1 responsibility-role normalization with the independently supported absent-fact omission and long self-sufficient evidence representation mechanisms.
claim_boundary: The current external five-job batch is now revealed development data. Passing these gates establishes deterministic recovery and regression safety on frozen data only; it does not establish generalization and does not authorize another model call.

v4_2_contract.input: Untrusted parsed JSON-compatible object returned by the frozen flat-v4 request contract.
v4_2_contract.output: A deep-copied JSON-compatible object plus an ordered immutable diagnostic list; the input object is never mutated.

pipeline_order.operation: Reuse the frozen v4.1 adapter unchanged: role=responsibility becomes item only when category=responsibility and level=mention.

pipeline_order.eligibility: fact mention is an object with raw_items exactly [], source_text exactly empty string, and level exactly null
pipeline_order.operation: Remove the complete fact element; preserve all other fact elements byte-for-byte and in order.

pipeline_order.eligibility: atom source_text length > 240; surface_item is a nonempty string of length <= 240; surface_item is an exact source_text substring; semantic_item equals surface_item
pipeline_order.operation: Replace only source_text with the existing surface_item.

fail_closed_policy: Malformed roots or arrays are returned unchanged except for independently eligible records in an existing list.
A partially matching fact placeholder is not omitted.
A long atom with null, overlong, unanchored, or semantic-divergent surface_item is not changed.
No missing field, semantic item, surface item, fact, category, level, relation, or qualifier is invented.
No company, title, URL, case id, corpus id, gold value, or fixture id is a runtime input.

requirements: Every frozen input hash matches before execution.
Model and network call counts are zero.
All treatment and report artifacts are created exclusively.
The three mechanisms execute exactly once in the registered order.
Only registered fields and eligible elements change.
The input objects remain unchanged.
Reverse transformation reconstructs each frozen input exactly.
Diagnostics contain only the three registered codes and exact before/after evidence.
All five cases become strict flat-v4 schema valid.
The four omission targets and one long-span target form a disjoint complete recovery partition.
All source_text and nonnull surface_item values in the output remain exact substrings of the corresponding full job body.
No atom count, fact value, semantic value, or noneligible evidence value changes.
v4.2 output exactly equals the previously frozen v4.1-normalized live output.
All previously passed live G1, G5, and G6 outcomes remain unchanged.
The two new mechanisms do not activate.
Every v4.2 output is byte-equivalent to its frozen dev-20 input.
All 20 responses remain strict schema valid.
No fact, atom, evidence, surface, or order changes.

positive_controls: Eligible responsibility alias changes only role and becomes strict valid.
Eligible exact empty absent fact is omitted and becomes strict valid.
Eligible long self-sufficient evidence changes only source_text and becomes strict valid.
One combined fixture activates all three mechanisms in pipeline order and becomes strict valid.
negative_controls: role=responsibility with category other than responsibility remains unchanged and invalid.
role=responsibility with level other than mention remains unchanged and invalid.
An empty fact with nonnull level remains unchanged and invalid.
An empty-items fact with nonempty source_text remains unchanged and invalid.
A nonempty-items fact with empty source_text remains unchanged and invalid.
A source_text of exactly 240 characters remains unchanged.
A long atom with null surface_item remains unchanged and invalid.
A long atom with surface_item longer than 240 remains unchanged and invalid.
A long atom whose surface_item is not an exact source substring remains unchanged and invalid.
A long atom whose semantic_item differs from surface_item remains unchanged and invalid.
requirements: Every positive control has exactly its registered activation count and validates after treatment.
Every negative control has zero activation for the tested mechanism and is byte-equivalent to input.
No invalid negative control is silently made valid by an unregistered repair.
The v4.1 adapter and all v4 sources retain their frozen hashes.
Focused v4.2 tests and the full regression suite pass.
Static audit finds no forbidden imports, fixture ids, or artifact reads in runtime code.
Leakage checks inspect request construction and structured fields rather than searching arbitrary words such as expected inside untrusted job text.

evaluation_protocol.failure_policy: Keep v4.1 as the latest accepted compatibility layer; retain the failed v4.2 report and diagnose only from frozen inputs.

on_full_pass: Freeze the v4.2 source and formal gate report as a development-qualified candidate.
Do not claim generalization from the revealed external five.
Only then collect and freeze a new public-job holdout whose URLs, bodies, companies, and responses were unavailable during v4.2 development.
Prefer at least two non-Ashby ATS hosts to address the current platform limitation.
Preregister the new holdout and request separate explicit authorization before any external transmission.
on_any_failure: Do not collect or call a new holdout.
Do not modify thresholds or rerun v4.2.
Retain v4.1 and classify the frozen failure offline before any new version.

next_allowed_action: Implement the isolated v4.2 adapter, evaluator, gate runner, and focused controls exactly as registered; freeze their hashes; then execute the development and regression gates once with zero model and network calls.
